content.text: Antes de começar os pronomes interrogativos, vamos relembrar rapidamente as preposições que vimos na aula passada:
I was sitting above the bench.
(Eu estava sentado em cima da arquibancada.)
Texto de prática da aula passada,
Maria mora perto do banco. Ela anda até lá toda manhã.
Seu amigo John trabalha perto da casa dela. Eles às vezes almoçam juntos.
Um dia, Maria perdeu a chave e procurou em todos os lugares: debaixo do sofá, debaixo da mesa... Finalmente, encontrou a chave em uma prateleira
Pronomes interrogativos são palavras usadas para
fazer perguntas que pedem informações específicas
, como motivo, lugar, pessoa, tempo ou modo.
Por que ela gosta de cachorros?
Do we study English every week?
Where do we study English every week?
Onde nós estudamos inglês toda semana?
Can he be a good brother?
Ele pode ser um bom irmão?
How can he be a good brother?
Como ele pode ser um bom irmão?
When am I a good friend?
Quando eu sou um bom amigo?
após o pronome interrogativo, exceto quando o pronome é sujeito (who, what).
Pronome interrogativo + auxiliar + sujeito + verbo + complemento?
Tom lives in a small town. He has a routine. He wakes up early every weekday and goes to work. To go to the office, he always takes the bus. He is never late.
But one day, something was different. The bus had a problem and was late. Because of this, the traffic was very bad. Tom was stuck and was late for work.
Anna, a friend of Tom's at work, saw he was not there. She was a little worried and called him.
"Hi Tom! Where are you? You are late!"
"Hi Anna. I'm on the bus. The traffic is very bad today."
"Traffic? But how do you go to work? You usually take the bus. Did something happen?"
"Yes, I'm on the bus. There was a small problem earlier."
"Oh, I see... But then, why are you late? Was it just because of the traffic?"
"Yes, the bus is very slow because of all the traffic."
"You scared me! Changing the subject... they told me we have a new boss. Who is your new boss?"
"It's Mr. Rodrigues. He started this week."
"Okay. And tell me, what do you eat for breakfast today to have energy?"
"I just ate a fruit quickly. I was in a hurry."
"Alright. I hope you arrive soon! When will you finish work today? Can we get coffee after?"
"Yes, we can! I'll tell you when I leave."
Answer the questions according to the text:
How does Tom usually go to work?
What happened to the bus one day?
What did Tom eat for breakfast that day?
What does Anna want to do with Tom after work?
